entries.proposition: Low-dose experiment: unilateral injection into the left lateral ventricle of adult mice.
entries.snippet: genomes AAV unilaterally directly into the left lateral ventricle by stereotactic injection
entries.anchor: Results, tropism in vitro and in vivo, para 3

entries.proposition: Injection volume was 10 microlitres at 0.5 microlitres per minute, 2 mm depth.
entries.snippet: Following infusion of 10 µl volume the needle remained in situ for 5 min

entries.proposition: Third-ventricle choroid plexus was poorly transduced despite transit through the foramen of Monro.
entries.snippet: third ventricle ChP was very poorly infected, though some green cells could be observed

entries.proposition: Contralateral choroid plexus transduction was considerably weaker than ipsilateral.
entries.snippet: Infection on the contralateral side was considerably weaker but present mainly dorsally

entries.proposition: The higher dose was chosen because low-dose distribution was inefficient.
entries.snippet: Due to the inefficient infection across the ventricle compartments in our EGFP experiment
entries.anchor: Results, Aqp1 editing in vivo, para 1

entries.proposition: Contralateral editing was significantly below injected-side editing but about two thirds of it.
entries.snippet: gene editing still occurred at two thirds of the level on the injected side
entries.anchor: Results, Aqp1 editing in vivo, para 2

entries.proposition: Strongest knockdown was caudal to the injection site, not at it.
entries.snippet: the strongest knockdown was not observed at the injection site, but more caudally

entries.proposition: Fourth-ventricle choroid plexus showed no significant knockdown.
entries.snippet: At the level of the fourth ventricle AAV-mediated knockdown of AQP1 is insignificant

entries.proposition: Fig. 6 right panels plot AQP1 optical density per level, injected versus contralateral, n of 4 points per group read from the rendered panel; the Fig. 6 percentages were recomputed from panel means (about 59/39, 78/55, 49/45 percent LV; 37 percent 3V).
entries.snippet: Right panels show fluorescent immunocytochemistry for choroid plexus AQP1 protein optical density

entries.proposition: Whether dose escalation can overcome the ipsilateral bias without toxicity has not been examined in detail, by the authors' statement.
entries.snippet: whether dose escalation could overcome the bias to the ipsilateral side without inducing toxicity has not yet been examined in detail

entries.proposition: The authors state distribution may scale non-linearly with dose and ventricular volume to human brains.
entries.snippet: may produce non-linear relationships with dose and ventricular volume during scaling to human brains

entries.proposition: The authors expect secreted-protein overexpression to be less dependent on near-total choroid plexus infection than knockdown.
entries.snippet: may succeed ahead of knockdown approaches as they are less dependent on near total ChPE infection

entries.proposition: Ventricular tropism was not examined in the explant system.
entries.snippet: It is a limitation of this study that tropism to ChP in different ventricular compartments was not examined in the explant culture system
